# Draft:Caixa Mágica Software

----
}}
Caixa Mágica Software is a Portuguese technology company specializing in open-source software, digital identity systems, and full-cycle software engineering. Based in Lisbon, the company is a frequent provider of technological infrastructure for the Portuguese government and international entities, notably for electronic identification systems.
History
Origins and Linux Caixa Mágica (2000–2011)
The project originated in 2000 at the ADETTI research center (associated with ISCTE – University Institute of Lisbon), aiming to develop a Linux distribution tailored to the Portuguese language and culture. In 2004, the founding team established the company as a spin-off to provide commercial support for the software.
The distribution gained national prominence through its integration into the Magalhães laptop project and the e-Escolinhas program, which distributed low-cost laptops to primary school students. The implementation of open-source software in public education was subsequently discussed in the Portuguese Parliament regarding technical and educational policies.
Diversification (2012–present)
Following the decline of desktop Linux distributions, Caixa Mágica transitioned into a software consultancy model. The company focused on developing middleware for smart cards and custom digital solutions for the health, energy, and judicial sectors. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the company developed the Covid Pass application for the Imprensa Nacional-Casa da Moeda (INCM) to facilitate digital certificate validation.
Major Projects
Digital Identity
Caixa Mágica is responsible for the open-source middleware of the Portuguese Citizen Card, which enables secure authentication and digital signatures for millions of users. This technology was also adapted for the electronic ID systems of other nations, such as Cape Verde.
Incubated Spin-offs
The company has served as an incubator for several independent technology ventures:
* Aptoide: An independent Android app store that originated as an internal project in 2011 before becoming a separate entity with global operations.
* WalliD: A decentralized identity protocol based on blockchain technology, launched in 2019.
